_meta.description: Authoritative standards/guidance URLs for KDP workbook and SEO content generation. Keys follow the pattern '{grade_id}_{subject_slug}' where grade_id matches WORKBOOK_GRADES in config.py and subject_slug is a snake_case slug of the subject name. Each entry is a list of {title, url, description} objects. Pre-K has no Common Core alignment; those entries emphasize developmentally appropriate practice (DAP) and developmental milestones instead.
